name: Transmittance Calculation via Ratio Tracking
definition: Transmittance represents the fraction of energy (photons) reaching a point from a source, acting as visibility. It decreases exponentially based on the volume's extinction attribute, following the Beer-Lambert law.
summary: Ratio Tracking is an unbiased Monte Carlo estimator for transmittance in heterogeneous media that handles spatially varying extinction by sampling distances and evaluating the ratio of samples exceeding the target distance.
